people.name: Asenath
people.line: Egyptian wife of Joseph; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: On
people.line: An ancient Egyptian city, mentioned in relation to Joseph

translations.web: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
translations.bsb: Before the years of famine arrived, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
translations.kjv: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare
translations.asv: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bare unto him.
